youtube_short.title: The 4% Rule Is Broken (You're $250K Short)
title_alternatives: Why Your Retirement Number Is $250,000 Wrong
The Broken Retirement Rule Nobody Told You About
youtube_short.description: The 4% safe withdrawal rule that everyone uses to plan retirement was calculated in 1994 when bonds paid nearly 7%. Today bonds pay half that, and people live a full decade longer — so the updated safe rate is 3.3%. That means you need $1.21 million, not $1 million, to safely pull $40,000 a year. That's a $210,000 gap most retirement calculators never show you. Follow for more money moves they don't teach you in school. #retirement #personalfinance #finance #moneytips #investing #retirementplanning
